messages:
tara-peopleops: Quick note 3 we've updated the handbook section on leave proration and the new 1099 opt-in process. Please read and complete the short acknowledgment + microtraining by Mon Apr 06 2026. https://handbook.redwood.com/leaves/proration

omar-eng: Do part-timers get an example calculation? A 0.5 FTE example would help.

tara-peopleops: Yes, added a 0.5 and 0.75 FTE example table and a one-line formula. See 'Proration Examples' on the page.

nina-manager: Managers: will we get a report of completions for our directs?

tara-peopleops: Yes, managers get a CSV export the day after reminders. We'll also push a short "what to say" blurb you can copy into team channels.

lms-bot: Reminder scheduled 4 Microtraining assigned tomorrow at 09:00 PT. Course link: https://lms.redwood.com/courses/leave-proration

omar-eng: If someone is already on approved leave, does the change affect them?

tara-peopleops: No retroactive adjustments for active leaves. New rules apply to leaves starting on or after the effective date (2026-04-01).

nina-manager: Great, can you add a note for international contractors? Our EMEA folks asked.

tara-peopleops: Added a short international contractor FAQ and the opt-in form link. If complex, ping me and we'll route to Legal/Finance.

omar-eng: Thanks  I'll mention this in our squad sync tomorrow.

tara-peopleops: Thanks all. Ping me for edge cases.
